not_signoff: Evidence, not sign-off. This audit cross-checks klt's own curated sky130 deck coverage report against the composed stream. It is not a foundry DRC runset, and it adds no antenna, density, seal-ring, latch-up or foundry-only rule. No ratified spec value is read or changed.

controls.intent: single-layer rule whose layer has no shapes -> vacuous-confirmed
single-layer rule whose layer HAS shapes but klt lists it inapplicable -> residual
a layer carrying only text objects has geometry 0: rule vacuous, unruled layer text-or-marker-only
rule id absent from the pinned deck -> unresolved
rule layer the deck layer table cannot resolve -> unresolved even though nothing is drawn
check kind the audit does not understand -> unresolved even though its layer is empty
two-layer enclosing rule, via3 present and capm absent -> vacuous-confirmed
two-layer enclosing rule, via3 and capm both present but klt lists it inapplicable -> residual
an unruled layer with drawn geometry -> present-unruled
the drift check must fail on a stream edit, a mapping change, and a deck-hash change, and pass unchanged

cases.change: one polygon added on 236/0 (an unruled layer) in the stream
drift: unruled_layers[236/0]: present-unruled flat=1 text=0 -> present-unruled flat=2 text=0
